jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Workplaces
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is hiring a Sr. Manager, Global Workplaces to build our workplace function from the ground up. This is a foundational role: there is no existing playbook to inherit, so you'll help design the policies, standards, and operating model that will support ClickHouse's workplace experience as we grow. You'll be responsible for a small but growing footprint of offices across multiple regions, and you'll need to balance our remote-first philosophy with the reality that in-person environments matter — for teams, culture, and moments that are hard to replicate over video.

This role reports to the Head of Procurement and will partner closely with People, IT, Security, Finance, and regional leaders. You should be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by building something new rather than maintaining something established.

What You Will Do:

• Workplace Function Build-Out: Design and stand up ClickHouse's global workplace function from scratch, including policies, standards, playbooks, and operating processes that can flex across regions and scale as we grow.

• Global Office Operations: Oversee day-to-day operations for ClickHouse's small offices across multiple regions, ensuring a consistent standard of experience while adapting to local norms, labor requirements, and regulations.

• Remote-First, In-Person-Enabled Strategy: Develop a workplace strategy that reflects our remote-first culture while creating high-value in-person environments — team hubs, offsites, and gathering spaces— that strengthen collaboration and connection.

• New Office Setup & Space Planning: Lead site selection, buildout, and launch of new small offices as ClickHouse expands into new regions, in partnership with Procurement, Finance, and Legal.

• Vendor & Facilities Management: Own vendor relationships across regions — broker, landlords, building management, facilities, food and beverage, and events — working closely with Procurement on sourcing and contract negotiation.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with People, IT, Security, and Finance on space planning,

onboarding logistics, workplace technology, and headcount-driven capacity planning across regions.

• Budget Ownership: Own the global workplace budget, track spend across regions, and identify

opportunities to optimize cost without compromising the employee experience.

• Policy & Process Development: Create scalable, well-documented workplace policies — health and safety, visitor management, workplace security, and office access — adaptable across jurisdictions.

• Events & Team Connection: Support company gatherings that reinforce culture and connection across a distributed team.

• Point of Contact & Escalations: Serve as the primary point of contact for office-related issues and emergencies across regions and time zones, establishing clear escalation protocols.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

• 7+ years of experience in workplace, facilities, corporate real estate, or global office operations, ideally including experience building a workplace function or program from the ground up.

• Experience supporting a globally distributed organization with multiple small offices across regions, and an understanding of the operational and regulatory differences that come with that footprint.

• Genuine enthusiasm for remote-first ways of working, paired with an appreciation for why in-person environments matter to teams — and the judgment to know when and how to invest in each.

• Strong vendor management and contract negotiation experience, with comfort partnering closely with a Procurement function.

• Experience managing a budget, with a track record of finding operational efficiencies.

• Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with People, IT, Security, and Finance teams.

• Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating autonomously in a role with significant ownership and limited existing infrastructure.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the cultural fluency to work effectively across regions, time zones, and languages.

• Based in the Americas or EMEA, with the flexibility to travel to regional offices as needed.

Nice to Have:

• Experience negotiating international leases or managing office buildouts outside your home country.

• Familiarity with health, safety, and workplace compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

• Experience designing workplace programs specifically for hybrid or remote-first organizations (e.g., home office stipends, co-working allowances, hub-based gathering strategies).

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

jobs.title: Global Expenses Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As ClickHouse scales, we're building the technology and operating foundation Finance needs to continue to enable our rapid growth. As part of that work, we're standing up a dedicated Travel & Expense (T&E) function and are looking for a Senior Expense Specialist responsible for maturing the current processes and day-to-day operational excellence.

What You'll Do:

Audit, Compliance & Risk

  • Own expense audit end-to-end

  • Build and maintain the SOX-ready control environment for T&E, including documentation, testing support, and sign-off readiness.

  • Track and reduce policy non-compliance, turning an untracked risk into a measured, managed one.

Global Policy & Program Ownership

  • Enforce one global, regionally compliant T&E policy — including EOR employees — to reduce local tax and audit exposure.

  • Centrally administer and optimize the ClickHouse Expense tool, Corporate Card program and system integrations to the HRIS and ERP systems.

Reimbursement & Employee Experience

  • Cut international reimbursement cycle time from ~30 days to ~7 through automated routing and clear SLAs.

  • Reduce the time employees spend per claim through better tooling, clearer policy, and self-service support.

  • Be the primary point of contact for T&E questions, escalations, and edge cases — approval flow issues, policy setup, and offboarding coordination with the People team

Reporting, Enablement & Change Management

  • Build spend dashboards, KPI tracking, and executive reporting where none exists today.

  • Deliver role-based training and a global T&E champion network, and lead structured change management (ADKAR or similar) to drive adoption of new policy and tools.

  • Partner with Accounting to complete the handoff of remaining T&E responsibilities.

What You Bring Along:

  • 4+ years of experience in travel & expense, accounts payable, or finance operations, ideally at a high-growth or Cloud software company with a distributed, multi-entity employee base.

  • Hands-on ownership of Expensify, Ramp (or a comparable card/expense platform), and NetSuite integrations — you know what breaks in these systems and how to fix it at the root, not just route the ticket.

  • Working knowledge of SOX controls and audit readiness for expense and card programs; experience building or maintaining automated fraud detection a plus.

  • Comfort designing policy for a global, multi-entity, multi-employment-type workforce (FTE and EOR, including platforms like Deel), and translating that policy into system configuration.

  • A track record of building reporting and KPI visibility from scratch — you don't wait for a dashboard to be handed to you, you build it.

  • Experience running training and change management for a process or tool rollout (ADKAR or similar frameworks a plus).

  • Ownership mentality: you see a broken process and fix the root cause, not just the ticket in front of you.

  • Independence: you troubleshoot issues, ask clarifying questions, and propose solutions rather than escalating every ambiguity.

  • Curiosity: you ask why a process exists before you automate it, and you're a lifelong learner when it comes to new systems.

  • Follow-through: you see initiatives through to full adoption, not just launch.

#LI-remote

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

The company's sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

We're hiring a Product Manager to own partner integrations at ClickHouse. This role owns how ClickHouse shows up inside the platforms our customers already use: embedded, native experiences across the hyperscalers and developer platforms, and deeper technical integrations with strategic partners like dbt, Fivetran, Hex, and Sigma. There is a growing surface of partner work already in motion, and this role shapes where we invest in co-innovation opportunities.

This is one of the most cross-functional roles at ClickHouse. You'll work across multiple engineering teams, our partnerships and solutions teams, and the partners themselves to deliver meaningful co-innovation and integrations with complementary technologies. You'll own the technical side of our House Mates partner program and be the person who navigates the multi-org reality of getting an integration certified, listed, and live. This is a hands-on role: you'll write the specs, run the partner calls, drive certification processes, and coordinate across teams to get things over the line.

You Will

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for ClickHouse's Cloud integrations with strategic partners

  • Seek out complementary innovation opportunities with partners. Define what a "better together" integration looks like with each strategic partner, and drive it from joint roadmap through launch.

  • Navigate the trade-offs of embedded integrations: billing and metering, identity and auth, security and data residency, and coordination across ClickHouse and partner teams.

  • Project-manage complex, multi-org launches: marketplace listings, certification processes, partner co-marketing, and GA timelines across multiple organizations.

  • Own the technical standards and certification criteria for integrations submitted through the House Mates partner program.

  • Measure and communicate co-innovation business impact, adoption and product strategy to executive leadership.

  • Represent ClickHouse externally at partner events and in joint content.

You Bring

  • Experience shipping integrations into third-party platforms before: hyperscaler marketplaces, embedded or native integrations, ISV partnerships, or OEM/white-label work.

  • An understanding of the trade-offs that make or break a partner integration, billing, auth, security, cross-team dependencies, and have made those decisions in the past.

  • A strong project management lens and are comfortable owning a launch that depends on five teams across two companies.

  • Patience and resilience with partners who are unresponsive or have their own competing priorities, and you find creative ways to keep things moving anyway.

  • Technical ability to understand an integration end to end, from provisioning and auth to billing and data flow, and to hold a credible conversation with engineers about APIs, architecture, and technical trade-offs.

  • Energy and excitement for external-facing work: partner calls, customer conversations, and representing the product publicly.

  • Hands-on and high ownership ability. You write the specs, run the partner calls, and stay close to the details.

  • Comfort in ambiguity and fast-moving environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience building partner integrations with hyperscalers and modern technology companies.

  • Experience running or supporting a technology partner program.

  • Background at a database or data infrastructure company; familiarity with ClickHouse or peers like Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.

  • Experience working in remote, multi-timezone environments.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Accountant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 4,000 customers and $250M ARR, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

 

The company's sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

 

We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Accountant to join our revenue accounting team. You will report to the Director of Order to Cash and Revenue Accounting and be responsible for executing the month-end close cycle for revenue recognition, including reconciliations for revenue and deferred revenue, reviewing customer contracts, and preparing financial reporting metrics such as RPO. You'll work cross-functionally with AR & Billing, Legal, Sales Operations, FP&A, and Data teams to build scalable, automated revenue processes.

You Will

  • Own the end-to-end monthly revenue close, preparing journal entries, reconciliations, and flux analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, and contract asset balances.

  • Prepare the deferred revenue waterfall and financial reporting metrics.

  • Reconcile consumption data to billing and revenue; use SQL/data queries and AI tools to assist and automate the work.

  • Review customer contracts and order forms under ASC 606, and prepare accounting checklist for complex or non-standard deals.

  • Prepare estimate calculations, including the standalone selling price (SSP) analyses.

  • Support new product introductions (NPI), new pricing models, SKU launches, and system upgrades or implementations.

  • Support external audits and manage PBC requests related to revenue.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with AR & Billing, Legal, Sales Operations, FP&A, and Data teams to improve the quote-to-revenue workflow.

You Bring

  • 3+ years of progressive accounting experience with a focus on revenue accounting, ideally at a SaaS or consumption-based technology company.

  • Strong working knowledge of ASC 606, including contract review, SSP, and revenue disclosures (deferred revenue, RPO).

  • Experience with NetSuite, Stripe, and Salesforce, and familiarity with the integrations and data flows among these systems; experience with cloud marketplace billing (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus.

  • Comfort working with large data sets; SQL or similar query skills, and an interest in using AI and automation to streamline processes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex contracts and data sets.

  • A quick learner with excellent attention to detail, organization, and communication skills; able to collaborate cross-functionally and explain revenue matters clearly.

  • CPA (or equivalent) and/or Big Four public accounting experience preferred.

  • Experience supporting audits, internal controls, and SOX readiness preferred.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager Architect - Japan
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is the open-source, real-time analytical database behind a lot of today's AI. More than 4,000 companies build on ClickHouse, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Tesla and Meta.

As a TAM Architect, you're the named technical lead for a small group of our largest customers. You carry the context of how they run ClickHouse, guide them from their first design decisions through production and growth, and make sure the rest of ClickHouse shows up for them when it matters. Your job is to keep them healthy, help them get more out of ClickHouse, and spot the next use case.

You'll work inside our Support organisation and own escalations for your accounts, working closely with our support engineers. The role is based in Japan, close to our customers in Tokyo.

Large enterprises are moving onto ClickHouse fast, and we're building out how we look after them. People joining now have a real say in how this role works.

 

What you'll do

  • Run a regular cadence with 4 to 8 strategic accounts (weekly, fortnightly or monthly, depending on the project), plus quarterly health checks and business reviews, on site where it helps

  • Lead onboarding, where the decisions that are hardest to reverse get made: schema and data modelling, table engines, ingestion, migration and query design

  • Once customers are live, keep performance and cost on track as they grow, and help them onto new use cases

  • Work closely with Support: own escalations for your accounts, with regular case reviews and a direct line into L3 engineering

  • Work with the right people for each piece of work: partner with Solutions Architects on new use cases and proof of concepts, and bring in Consulting Engineers for hands-on projects

  • Write it down: documented setup and configuration, knowledge base articles and reference architectures that help other customers too

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in a hands-on, customer-facing technical role after the sale, whether your title was TAM, solutions architect, professional services, senior support or something else

  • Specialist depth in data modelling, query performance and integration on distributed or analytical databases

  • Hands-on SQL. You regularly write complex queries from scratch, and tune and debug them yourself

  • Experience owning a small book of high-touch enterprise accounts, where you know each customer's architecture in depth

  • Hands-on cloud experience (AWS, GCP and/or Azure)

  • You've run distributed systems, such as distributed databases, in production

  • You explain technical trade-offs clearly, to engineers and to executives

  • Fluent English and Japanese

Nice to have

  • Experience with ClickHouse, or with other analytical databases such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Druid

  • Involvement in open source, as a user, contributor or community member

  • A working knowledge of Kubernetes

Good to know

  • You'll be based in Japan. Travel to customer sites is part of the job, up to 35% of your time, mostly to customers in Tokyo

  • You'll join our APJ Support Services team, alongside Support Engineers and Consulting Engineers

  • You'll be part of the on-call rota, about one week a quarter, with time off in lieu if you're paged at a weekend

How we hire

  • A 30-minute call with our recruiter

  • A conversation with the hiring manager

  • A take-home exercise, designed to take four to five hours, with three working days to complete it

  • A 90-minute technical interview with the team: you'll walk us through your take-home, then join a working session where you write and tune SQL live

  • An in-person meeting with our local head of solutions architecture

  • A final conversation with our VP of Support Services

  • References, then an offer

The working session is without AI tools, so make sure you're comfortable writing queries from scratch. Download open-source ClickHouse and practise: it's free, easy to install, and great preparation.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

jobs.title: テクニカルアカウントマネージャー アーキテクト - 日本
jobs.descriptionHtml:
テクニカルアカウントマネージャー(「TAM」)アーキテクトは、サポートサービスチームおよびサポートグループのメンバーとして、地域のサポートエンジニアリングマネージャーの配下に置かれる予定です。この新しい役職は、既存チームが一部担っている機能を遂行します。具体的には、コンサルティングサポート、エスカレーション対応の洞察、監督といった機能を、複数の顧客に対して継続的にTAM業務、コンサルティング業務、サポート業務として提供します。TAMアーキテクトはまた、エンタープライズ顧客のサポートケースにL3(サポートレベル3=エスカレーション対応)として対応します。

注:本ポジションは日本での採用となります。東京の顧客に対面でサポートを提供するための出張が発生します。

TAMアーキテクトとして成功するためには、以下の適性とアプローチが求められます:

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is looking for Growth Engineers who are obsessed with both craft UI and agentic experiences. You care about the button, the empty state, and the agent that helps someone get unstuck, and you care equally about whether any of it moved the number.

You’ll join our growth pod to build experimentation infrastructure, onboarding flows, and product surfaces across the self-serve funnel: classic human UI and AI-assisted / agent-driven flows. You’ll work side by side with unified console engineers, but your mandate is speed and impact: ship something testable, measure it, and iterate. You’re motivated by moving a number and learning fast, more than by getting every detail right on the first try.

This is a new role at ClickHouse. You’ll help define what growth engineering looks like here: PLG experimentation that spans human and agentic experiences. You’ll work closely with product, design, and data science on one pod, and partner with unified console and app teams on shared product surfaces.

What you will do:

  • Build and ship experiments across the self-serve funnel: signup, onboarding, activation, and monetization flows.

  • Design and polish human UI (flows, forms, empty states, navigation, microcopy surfaces) with a high bar for clarity and conversion.

  • Design and ship agentic experiences (AI-assisted onboarding, in-product agents, guided workflows) that help users reach value faster.

  • Run disciplined experiments on both: hypothesis, instrumentation, ship, learn. Tools like GrowthBook are part of the day-to-day.

  • Partner closely with product, design, and data science to go from idea to shipped experiment quickly.

  • Work within the Cloud Console codebase alongside unified console engineers, and partner with app teams (including Observability, Agents, and Postgres) on strong end-to-end user flows.

  • Obsess over metrics: acquisition, activation, and monetization. You want proof that what you shipped moved the needle.

Requirements:

  • Experienced in full-stack product engineering (TypeScript / Node / React), ideally including time on a growth, product, or experimentation-focused team.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with real taste for product UI.

  • Experience building with LLMs or agent patterns in a product (tool calling, streaming, evals, system/prompt design), or a clear track record of shipping AI features you measured and iterated on.

  • Comfortable shipping a smaller, testable version of an idea first, then iterating based on what you learn.

  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and JSON.

  • Experience with experimentation or A/B testing tools (e.g. GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly), or strong interest in building that muscle.

  • Proficient with Git and collaborative code review.

  • Excellent communication skills. You’ll work daily with PM, design, data science, marketing, and other engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • You’ve shipped both polished UI experiments and agentic / AI-assisted product experiences (not just prototypes), with instrumentation and iteration.

  • Experience on a growth or product-led-growth team, ideally at a company with a self-serve funnel.

  • Experience with ClickHouse or other data-intensive/analytics products.

  • Familiarity with Auth0 or similar auth integrations.

  • Experience working closely with (but not necessarily reporting into) a separate platform or infrastructure engineering team.

  • You have opinions on what makes great human UX and great agent UX, and you use AI heavily in your own workflow.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - ClickPipes Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The ClickPipes team builds the services that power data ingestion into ClickHouse Cloud. As a primary entry point for customers’ data, ClickPipes is critical to product adoption and the company’s growth. We work at petabyte scale, solving challenges in distributed systems, fault tolerance, and high-throughput ingestion. You’ll help make these pipelines performant, reliable, and easy to operate, with ownership of technical decisions and the platform as a whole.

You can find some of the team’s recent work highlighted in our blog:

  • GCP Pub/Sub connector for ClickPipes is now in Private Preview

  • Terraform & OpenAPI for ClickPipes is now Generally Available

  • Unordered mode for GCS ClickPipes is now available

We’re looking for backend engineers with experience in data-intensive systems who enjoy working across technologies. You’ll collaborate with engineering and product partners and drive projects from design through production.

What will you do?

  • Build and evolve integrations with streaming platforms and object storage, including Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage.

  • Continuously improve our systems based on operational metrics, customer feedback, and evolving business requirements.

  • Drive technical discussions and contribute to architectural decisions that impact our platform's scalability and resilience.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to ensure system reliability and respond to production incidents.

About you:

  • 5+ years of software development experience building and operating distributed systems.

  • Strong knowledge of Go and its ecosystem.

  • Experience designing systems for scalability and fault tolerance, with an understanding of concurrency, consistency, and failure recovery.

  • Understanding of cloud-native architecture and practical experience with at least one major cloud provider.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving production issues in distributed systems.

  • Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate across engineering and product teams.

  • Experience with data ingestion pipelines, streaming platforms, or object storage is a plus.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

The AI/ML Engineering team builds and operates ClickHouse's AI and machine learning products end-to-end. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Postgres
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About ClickHouse

Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With over 2,000 customers and ARR that has more than quadrupled over the past year, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads. We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

About the Team

The Managed Postgres team is building ClickHouse's fully managed Postgres service. It gives developers a fast, reliable Postgres that works natively alongside ClickHouse, so one platform covers both transactional and real-time analytical workloads. This is a strategic, high-visibility initiative, and the user experience we build will shape how thousands of developers create, manage, monitor, and scale their databases.

About the Role

We're looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to help build responsive, performant, and elegant interfaces that make complex database operations feel simple. You'll work closely with product, design, and backend engineers, and you'll learn from senior engineers while owning real features from day one.

What You'll Do

  • Turn designs and user requirements into intuitive, high-quality interfaces for the Managed Postgres experience in ClickHouse Cloud.

  • Build features end-to-end: React and TypeScript on the frontend, plus integration with (and contributions to) backend APIs.

  • Build data-rich UIs for metrics, diagnostics, backups, replication, and performance insights.

  • Contribute to click-ui, our open-source design system, and follow frontend best practices: code quality, performance, accessibility, and testing.

  • Give product and design feedback from a developer's point of view.

About You

  • Experience: 1–4 years in frontend or full-stack development.

  • Core skills: Solid React, TypeScript, and modern frontend fundamentals (state management, component architecture, data fetching).

  • Backend exposure: Comfortable working with REST APIs; Node.js, Go, or similar is a plus.

  • Collaboration: You enjoy working closely with designers and backend engineers across a global team.

  • Developer empathy: You care about fast, clear, purposeful UIs for technical users.

  • Ownership: You take initiative, ask good questions, and carry work from idea to delivery.

  • Growth mindset: You're keen to learn and grow your scope quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Postgres, SQL, or database tooling

  • Accessibility (WCAG) knowledge

  • Data visualization or dashboard experience

  • Open-source contributions

Why Join Us

  • Shape the future of the Postgres user experience inside one of the fastest-growing data platforms.

  • Real ownership and autonomy from day one.

  • Learn from experts in databases, distributed systems, and developer experience.

  • Solve meaningful problems in performance, scale, and usability.

 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

jobs.title: Certification Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Learning Team at ClickHouse is growing fast as more and more users discover the power of ClickHouse and need to understand how to use it effectively. As part of that growth, we want to expand our certification program. We currently offer credentialed badges for completion of courses and one performance-based ClickHouse Certified Developer exam for those who are subject matter experts. We are looking for someone to take ownership of our certification program, expand our certification exam offerings, and build a community around our ClickHouse certified professionals.

Responsibilities:

  • Developing performance-based, hands-on ClickHouse certification exams on ClickHouse use cases like real-time analytics, observability and data warehousing

  • Working with company SME's to create job task analyses for exams

  • Grading and maintaining all certification exams, including writing grading scripts

  • Developing quizzes for our course-completion badges

  • Writing and deploying quizzes for ClickHouse credentials

  • Establishing a community presence for ClickHouse certified professionals using popular social media outlets and also while attending ClickHouse user conferences and Meetups

  • Tracking and reporting on the metrics and KPIs of the certification program

  • Working with the certification and badging vendors to ensure proper delivery of the exams and badges

  • Handling customer support from learners interested in obtaining our certifications

  • Traveling occasionally to Meetups and conferences to promote ClickHouse to the community

Requirements:

  • A self-motivated attitude that provides you with the desire and determination to complete projects in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Proven experience developing certification exams and quizzes for a highly technical audience like software engineers and database developers

  • Experience with SQL

  • Technical breadth and depth in relevant subjects such as DBMS, OLAP, Cloud/SaaS platforms, distributed systems software engineering, and big data

  • You have a high level of responsibility, ownership, and accountability

  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and effectively

  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus points:

  • 5+ years of experience in certification in the technical software industry

  • Experience with curriculum development or instruction for databases and/or distributed systems

  • Experience with ClickHouse database

  • Experience with one or more Cloud Service Providers such as AWS, GCP, Azure

  • Experience building software certification exams

  • Ability to work cross-functionally amongst engineering, support, product and development teams

  • Technical degree (e.g. Computer Science or related field)

You'll love this role if:

  • You thrive in a customer-facing role, collaborating closely with Engineering, Marketing and Sales teams

  • You are self-driven, curious, and eager to continuously learn and grow

  • You possess a mindset of teamwork, global engagement, empathy, and a drive for solving challenging problems

  • You have a sense of adventure and urgency in building the most scalable, highest performing, largest, and fastest databases in the world

Perks

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Billing & Marketplaces
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse Cloud, the fully managed version of the open source ClickHouse database, is available on AWS, GCP, and Azure. Customers can purchase directly from ClickHouse or through the cloud marketplaces. Billing is how every ClickHouse product reaches customers and shows up in our financials. As we add new products and new ways to buy, we are investing in our billing platform to scale with them. As Principal Product Manager for Billing and Marketplaces, you will lead that work and report to the Director of Product Management, Billing and Marketplaces.

What you will do:

  • Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for billing, from usage metering through invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition, working alongside the product managers and engineering leads of our metering and pricing, billing platform, and payments teams.

  • Evolve our metering and pricing foundation into a single metrics pipeline that new products can reuse, where the same metric can be priced differently by product and tier, and only net-new metrics need code changes.

  • Evolve our prepaid commit capabilities, with flexibility for customer-specific rate cards or metric-level discounts, contract changes and rollovers, and customer-facing balance visibility and spend alerts.

  • Own our cloud marketplace strategy and integrations across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including private offers, usage reporting, and subscription linking.

  • Lead the evaluation of billing architecture, from build versus buy decisions and POCs through migration plans and a clear recommendation to senior leadership.

  • Give Finance, Data, and Sales Ops systems they can trust, including ERP and revenue recognition sync, period close, audit controls, and SOX and SOC 2 readiness.

  • Partner with product teams, Product Marketing, Sales, and Support to launch billing for new products and pricing models, and serve as the company's subject matter expert on how customers are billed.

  • Mentor other product managers and help build the team.

About You:

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years owning billing, metering, payments, or commercial platforms for a cloud or usage-based product.

  • Deep expertise in usage-based pricing, prepaid credits, and committed spend contracts, and in how they translate into systems, invoices, and revenue.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure marketplaces, including private offers, co-sell, entitlements, metering APIs, and disbursements.

  • Familiarity with payments across card, invoice, marketplace, and partner channels, including dunning and delinquency flows, fraud detection, and payment notifications.

  • Strong understanding of order-to-cash, including invoicing, payment processing, tax, multi-currency, ERP integration, and revenue recognition.

  • Experience with third-party billing and payment platforms, such as Stripe or a usage-based billing vendor.

  • A track record of designing and maturing a product area from v1 and leading complex programs across engineering, Finance, and go-to-market teams.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting trade-offs to executives and explaining billing concepts to non-technical audiences.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience at an infrastructure, database, or developer platform company.

  • Comfortable going deep with engineers on event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and idempotency, and fluent enough in SQL to analyze billing data yourself.

  • Speaking or published thought leadership on usage-based pricing, billing, or cloud marketplaces.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Billing & Marketplaces
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse Cloud, the fully managed version of the open source ClickHouse database, is available on AWS, GCP, and Azure. Customers can purchase directly from ClickHouse or through the cloud marketplaces. Billing is how every ClickHouse product reaches customers and shows up in our financials. As we add new products and new ways to buy, we are investing in our billing platform to scale with them. As Principal Product Manager for Billing and Marketplaces, you will lead that work and report to the Director of Product Management, Billing and Marketplaces.

What you will do:

  • Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for billing, from usage metering through invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition, working alongside the product managers and engineering leads of our metering and pricing, billing platform, and payments teams.

  • Evolve our metering and pricing foundation into a single metrics pipeline that new products can reuse, where the same metric can be priced differently by product and tier, and only net-new metrics need code changes.

  • Evolve our prepaid commit capabilities, with flexibility for customer-specific rate cards or metric-level discounts, contract changes and rollovers, and customer-facing balance visibility and spend alerts.

  • Own our cloud marketplace strategy and integrations across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including private offers, usage reporting, and subscription linking.

  • Lead the evaluation of billing architecture, from build versus buy decisions and POCs through migration plans and a clear recommendation to senior leadership.

  • Give Finance, Data, and Sales Ops systems they can trust, including ERP and revenue recognition sync, period close, audit controls, and SOX and SOC 2 readiness.

  • Partner with product teams, Product Marketing, Sales, and Support to launch billing for new products and pricing models, and serve as the company's subject matter expert on how customers are billed.

  • Mentor other product managers and help build the team.

About You:

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years owning billing, metering, payments, or commercial platforms for a cloud or usage-based product.

  • Deep expertise in usage-based pricing, prepaid credits, and committed spend contracts, and in how they translate into systems, invoices, and revenue.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure marketplaces, including private offers, co-sell, entitlements, metering APIs, and disbursements.

  • Familiarity with payments across card, invoice, marketplace, and partner channels, including dunning and delinquency flows, fraud detection, and payment notifications.

  • Strong understanding of order-to-cash, including invoicing, payment processing, tax, multi-currency, ERP integration, and revenue recognition.

  • Experience with third-party billing and payment platforms, such as Stripe or a usage-based billing vendor.

  • A track record of designing and maturing a product area from v1 and leading complex programs across engineering, Finance, and go-to-market teams.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting trade-offs to executives and explaining billing concepts to non-technical audiences.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience at an infrastructure, database, or developer platform company.

  • Comfortable going deep with engineers on event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and idempotency, and fluent enough in SQL to analyze billing data yourself.

  • Speaking or published thought leadership on usage-based pricing, billing, or cloud marketplaces.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Control Plane Platform Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

The Control Plane Platform team is building the shared foundation that every product in ClickHouse Cloud is built and shipped on. We give ClickHouse engineering teams one place to own and deploy their product, remove the overhead of rebuilding common plumbing, and keep the customer experience consistent as the number of integrating teams grows. The team owns API gateways and API standards, shared platform services, deployment and infrastructure patterns, testing and CI, local developer experience and Control Plane observability.

About the role

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Platform team. This is a high-impact, high-trust role at the center of our Cloud product, combining people leadership, technical direction, product thinking, and operational ownership while maintaining the reliability customers expect.

You’ll work hand-in-hand with Product, Infrastructure, Security, Support, and engineering teams across ClickHouse.

This role goes beyond engineering leadership. Together with your team, you’ll help shape how new products and teams will integrate and deploy their applications in ClickHouse Cloud.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team - recruit to a high bar, set crisp expectations, give direct feedback and career development, and manage performance — while fostering a healthy, inclusive environment built on empathy, psychological safety, trust, and a high technical bar.

  • Own outcomes across the platform surface: API gateways and API standards, shared platform services (event bus, notifications, feature flags, websockets, audit records), deployment and infrastructure patterns, CI and testing, local developer experience, disaster recovery, and Control Plane observability.

  • Treat the integrating teams as your customers and measure success by their delivery velocity and adoption of the platform, not only by what your team ships.

  • Guide architecture and help senior engineers make explicit, sound tradeoffs. land cross-cutting migrations, deprecations, and contract changes across teams without stalling product delivery.

  • Jump into designs and code for complex areas - gateway routing and auth/RBAC enforcement, spec-driven code generation, event delivery semantics and idempotency, multi-region rollout safety.

  • Build the culture of operational excellence: Own SLOs, reliability, on-call quality, and cost-efficiency for k8s-hosted, multi-tenant services across cloud regions.

  • Systematize support, reduce toil, and build self-serve/auto-healing capabilities - golden-path templates and generators, auto-healing, and documentation that gets a new team integrated in days rather than weeks.

  • Shape the platform vision, turn it into a roadmap, sequence bets for business impact, and ship fast with tight feedback loops — including writing the RFCs that build cross-org consensus before big changes land

What you bring

  • 8+ years in software engineering and 3+ years managing software engineers with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong talent.

  • Experience leading a platform or infrastructure team whose customers are other engineering teams — you've driven adoption and cross-org migrations through influence and good tooling rather than mandate.

  • Experience leading distributed global teams, fostering an inclusive and autonomous culture, and creating clarity across time zones.

  • Experience building scalable, highly available, and secure cloud-based infrastructure in AWS (EKS, SQS, DocumentDB, Redis, PostgreSQL, Lambdas) with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm) and progressive delivery (Argo Rollouts or similar).

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), including patterns for hosting many independently deployed applications in a shared cluster.

  • Familiarity with API platform work: OpenAPI-driven contracts, API gateways, and the shared concerns they centralize — authentication, RBAC, rate limiting, versioning, and deprecation.

  • A track record of decomposing a monolith into independently deployable services without stalling product delivery.

  • Technical credibility to engage deeply in architecture and incidents without owning daily implementation.

  • Hands-on: you still enjoy diving into code/designs for complex or critical areas, reviewing code, and guiding via feedback.

  • Strong execution judgment across ambiguity, parallel workstreams, risk, and long-term system health.

Nice to have

  • Experience with large TypeScript/Node monorepos and the developer-experience problems that come with them: CI scale and flakiness, build and test times, local development environments, and code generation from specs.

  • Designed and implemented strategies for load balancing, auto-scaling, disaster recovery, and failover for cloud environments.

  • Experience building CI/CD at scale

  • Experience with internal developer platforms: service catalogs, golden-path templates, and self-service app scaffolding.

  • Proficiency with frontend frameworks (React).

  • Experience making APIs consumable by AI agents — MCP servers, CLIs, or skills generated from API specs.

  • Experience with ClickHouse

  • Previous experience in developing analytics or data-intensive applications.

Why This Role

  • Shape how all feature teams in ClickHouse Cloud develop and integrate with each other

  • Operate with ownership, autonomy, and speed while keeping the company lean.

  • Lead a technical team where correctness, performance, reliability, and developer experience all matter.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

 - Jump into designs and code for complex areas - gateway routing and auth/RBAC enforcement, spec-driven code generation, event delivery semantics and idempotency, multi-region rollout safety.

 - Build the culture of operational excellence: Own SLOs, reliability, on-call quality, and cost-efficiency for k8s-hosted, multi-tenant services across cloud regions.

 - Systematize support, reduce toil, and build self-serve/auto-healing capabilities - golden-path templates and generators, auto-healing, and documentation that gets a new team integrated in days rather than weeks.

 - Shape the platform vision, turn it into a roadmap, sequence bets for business impact, and ship fast with tight feedback loops — including writing the RFCs that build cross-org consensus before big changes land

What you bring

 - 8+ years in software engineering and 3+ years managing software engineers with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong talent.

 - Experience leading a platform or infrastructure team whose customers are other engineering teams — you've driven adoption and cross-org migrations through influence and good tooling rather than mandate.

 - Experience leading distributed global teams, fostering an inclusive and autonomous culture, and creating clarity across time zones.

 - Experience building scalable, highly available, and secure cloud-based infrastructure in AWS (EKS, SQS, DocumentDB, Redis, PostgreSQL, Lambdas) with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm) and progressive delivery (Argo Rollouts or similar).

 - Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), including patterns for hosting many independently deployed applications in a shared cluster.

 - Familiarity with API platform work: OpenAPI-driven contracts, API gateways, and the shared concerns they centralize — authentication, RBAC, rate limiting, versioning, and deprecation.

 - A track record of decomposing a monolith into independently deployable services without stalling product delivery.

 - Technical credibility to engage deeply in architecture and incidents without owning daily implementation.

 - Hands-on: you still enjoy diving into code/designs for complex or critical areas, reviewing code, and guiding via feedback.

 - Strong execution judgment across ambiguity, parallel workstreams, risk, and long-term system health.

Nice to have

 - Experience with large TypeScript/Node monorepos and the developer-experience problems that come with them: CI scale and flakiness, build and test times, local development environments, and code generation from specs.

 - Experience building CI/CD at scale

 - Experience with internal developer platforms: service catalogs, golden-path templates, and self-service app scaffolding.

 - Proficiency with frontend frameworks (React).

 - Experience making APIs consumable by AI agents — MCP servers, CLIs, or skills generated from API specs.

 - Operate with ownership, autonomy, and speed while keeping the company lean.

PERKS

jobs.title: Principal, Technical GTM Enablement
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The role

ClickHouse is the fastest, most resource-efficient open-source database for real-time analytics, and ClickHouse Cloud is growing across every region and segment. Our Solution Architects (SAs) are the technical heart of that growth: They run the proofs of concept, defend the architecture, and win the room against the largest data platforms in the world.

You will be the single owner of global technical sales enablement and SA onboarding at ClickHouse. You are integral in deciding what a ClickHouse SA needs to know, say and do in order to be successful, and you wholly own the build out of the programs to get them there. You will measure everything, incorporate AI, and drive real results that time to revenue impact. You are the connective tissue between Product, Product Marketing, Sales leadership, SA leadership, and the field.

This is a Principal-level individual contributor role. You lead through influence, the systems you build, and the credibility you earn.

What you'll own

Global SA onboarding

  • Design and run the end-to-end onboarding program for new SAs across AMER, EMEA, and APJ. These include but are not limited to: Technical foundations, ClickHouse architecture and internals, demo and POC craft, discovery and objection handling, competitive positioning, and our sales process.

  • Define and certify ramp. Set clear 30/60/90-day milestones, build the certification and shadow-to-lead progression, and publish time-to-productivity as a metric leadership can see and trust.

  • Make onboarding regionally real. Adapt the global program to how each theater sells, and coordinate cohort schedules, mentors, and live sessions across time zones.

Technical sales enablement strategy and everboarding

  • Own the global technical enablement plan and its calendar. This includes the quarterly priorities, the programs behind them, and the communication that keeps SA and Sales leadership aligned on what is shipping and why.

  • Run product-launch readiness for the field. Partner with Product and PMM so SAs have talk tracks, demo environments, hands-on labs, and competitive positioning before General Availability.

  • Build the competitive and architecture curriculum. Deep dives, battlecards, and objection-handling playbooks against the platforms we meet most (cloud data warehouses, search and observability stacks, and incumbent OLAP systems).

  • Extend enablement to adjacent technical roles as needed: Account Executives on technical fundamentals, Support on the sales motion, and partners on positioning.


Diagnose, then prescribe

  • Start from signals, not requests. Use call recordings, CRM data, win/loss, POC outcomes, certification results, and conversations with SA leaders to find the skill gaps that actually cost us deals, then classify and prioritize them with data.

  • Pick the right modality for the gap: hands-on lab, self-serve path, live workshop, AI role-play, peer teaching, or in-the-moment coaching. Measure behavior change and deal outcomes.

  • Close the loop. Systematically capture what is breaking in the field (friction, lost deals, recurring objections) and route it to Product, PMM, and Sales leadership as actionable recommendations.

Build at scale

  • Own the enablement toolchain: the LMS or learning hub, content repositories, certification tracking, and reporting. Keep a single source of truth for what is current.

  • Activate SME communities. Identify and support the SAs who are already the best at something, and give them the structure to teach it peer-to-peer across regions.

Stay in the field

  • Spend roughly 10% of your time in customer-facing moments by joining POCs, account reviews, and live coaching.

  • Facilitate. You will personally deliver live sessions, virtually and in person, at onboarding cohorts, regional kickoffs, and Kickoff events.

Operate like an owner

  • Report on readiness. Define the KPIs (ramp time, certification rates, POC win rate, technical win contribution, workshop effectiveness) and present them in monthly and quarterly business reviews.

  • Manage the portfolio. Run multiple programs in parallel, protect the plan from ad-hoc drift, and say no with a reason and an alternative.

  • Expand the charter. This role will grow, potentially into hiring and leading a team, owning SKO technical tracks, partner enablement, or a technical certification program for customers.

What success looks like in the first year

  • Every new SA worldwide goes through one global onboarding program with a defined ramp, and time-to-first-solo-POC is measured and trending down.

  • SAs are enabled on every major launch before GA, with demo environments and competitive positioning ready on day one.

  • Technical enablement priorities are set from field data and reviewed with SA and Sales leadership on a fixed cadence, and leadership can point to the deals and metrics that moved.

  • A living competitive and architecture curriculum exists, is current, and is used by SAs and, increasingly, by AEs.

  • SA leaders describe you as part of their extended leadership team, not a service desk.

What you bring

Required

  • 3+ years in a quota-carrying role. You have owned a number as an Account Executive, quota-carrying Solutions Engineer, or equivalent, and you know what it feels like when the quarter is on the line.

  • 8+ years total across solutions engineering, technical pre-sales, or technical enablement at an enterprise software or data infrastructure company, including experience building and running enablement or onboarding programs.

  • Deep hands-on data fluency: strong SQL, knowledge of OLAP/analytical databases, data warehousing architectures, streaming and ingestion pipelines, and at least one major cloud. You can run a demo, debug a lab, and read a query plan.

  • You have been the engineer in the room. You have run POCs, handled objections live, and defended a technical position against a well-funded competitor.

  • Proven program design and delivery: Needs analysis, curriculum design, facilitation (virtual and in person), certification, and measurement for a technical, global audience.

  • A self-starter with a bias for building. You create the plan when there is none, you ship version one before it is perfect, and you improve it from evidence.

  • Leads through influence. You can secure sponsorship from VPs, align cross-functional peers, and hold the field to a standard without a reporting line.

  • Data-driven and operational: comfortable pulling your own CRM and call-intelligence reports, defining KPIs, and debating the numbers with stakeholders.

  • Exceptional communicator. You make complex technical concepts accessible without dumbing them down, in writing and on stage.

  • Global mindset. Experience working across AMER, EMEA, and APJ time zones, and willingness to travel up to ~25% for cohorts, kickoffs, and field time.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with ClickHouse.

  • Experience at a high-growth infrastructure company through a major product launch or rapid SA headcount expansion.

  • Background in both pre-sales and post-sales technical roles.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tooling to automate content creation, build internal tools, or scale enablement beyond live delivery.

  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar) and with adult-learning or instructional-design principles.

  • Experience building SME networks, peer-learning cohorts, or technical certification programs.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Architect-Sydney
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is on a mission to grow a vibrant user community and establish ourselves as a cloud-first company. We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect to help expand our presence in Australia by empowering customers and users to unlock the full potential of ClickHouse. This is an exciting opportunity to join after the general availability of our serverless Cloud product and play a pivotal role in defining how it is positioned and adopted in the market.

Our ideal candidate is a technical thought leader with strong customer facing skills, capable of bridging business objectives with technical solutions. In this role, you’ll serve as a trusted advisor, guiding clients on how to leverage ClickHouse for real time analytics, cloud native applications, and enterprise-scale workloads.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, covering architecture, migrations, workflows, and data visualization.

  • Work directly with stakeholders across every level; from the C-suite to data scientists and developers, to enable customer success.

  • Evangelize ClickHouse’s vision and capabilities, driving adoption and securing strategic commitments.

  • Apply a solution based approach to demonstrate and deliver customer value.

  • Lead new initiatives that help customers transform raw data into actionable insights aligned with their business outcomes.

What You Bring

  • 5+ of experience with open source software business models; strong proficiency in cloud and infrastructure technologies.

  • Hands on experience with scalable, highly available distributed systems.

  • Proven ability to create proofs of concept (POCs) and reference implementations that drive customer adoption.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience deploying applications or selling into environments with major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

  • Familiarity with database programming and data modeling.

 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Customer Support Engineer - Singapore
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are currently growing our support team at ClickHouse who provides excellent service to our customers around the world. We are seeking a Senior Technical Customer Support Engineer to join our global Support Engineering team. We hope to find you ready to take on a large variety of tasks related to our customers locally in Singapore, as well as more regionally across APJ, APAC, and EMEA. This is a customer-facing role that will include customer interactions via chat, calls, Slack messages, and virtual meetings over video. You will be owning a wide variety of tasks: from triaging support tickets to user community support, helping with both pre- and post- sales customer activities, partnering with our Go To Market team with deeply technical aspects of POCs, and suggesting improvements to how we do things in Support at ClickHouse. This is a great opportunity for someone ready to roll-up their sleeves and help us continue to provide excellent customer support to our rapidly growing user base.

Note: This is a remote position, but candidates must be located in Singapore.

What you will be doing:

  • Supporting and guiding our ClickHouse users, customers, and prospects via cases, chat, Slack, community, and meetings

  • Develop solutions based on ClickHouse Cloud and ClickHouse open-source that can be shared with our users, community, and customers via documentation, knowledge base, blogs, meetups, webinars, and training

  • Work closely with our global Support Services, Engineering, Go to Market, and Product Management teams to help define functionality required by users and customers

  • Assist with mentoring, training, and sharing your knowledge with colleagues, users, and customers 

And of course:

  • You will deliver excellent customer service as a first-line technical engineer and representative of ClickHouse. Our Support Engineers provide professional response, on-call coverage, and guidance within the required Service Level Agreements ("SLAs") on technical cases that are opened via a ticketing system, email, Slack, chat, and/or phone

  • You will build strong, trusted relationships with colleagues, customers, and partners

What you bring along:

  • Technical breadth and depth in ClickHouse open-source or ClickHouse Cloud, or in domains relevant to ClickHouse, such as: SQL databases, OLAP, cloud-native SaaS, distributed systems

  • Previous technical experience in roles such as Support Engineer, Consultant, Database Administrator, Site Reliability Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Software Engineer, and/or Systems Engineer

  • Be present and available according to the scheduling required to deliver high-quality 24x7 Support in a global, distributed environment

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills and the ability to work fully remote with reliable connectivity

  • A mindset of teamwork, global engagement, empathy, and solving challenging problems

  • A sense of adventure and urgency in building the most scalable, high-performing, largest, and fastest databases on the planet

  • The ability to build trusted relationships with colleagues, customers, and partners

  • You are self-driven, curious, and eager to continuously learn and grow

Bonus points:

  • Experience with ClickHouse

  • Experience with OSS and open-source technologies, as a user, community member, or contributor

  • Experience with Azure, GCP or AWS

  • Experience with data pipelines such as Kafka, Kinesis, Spark, RabbitMQ, or others

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer - Product Metrics (Remote)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

The Product Metrics team owns the collection, storage, and serving of metrics collected from customers' ClickHouse instances. As a part of the team you will be responsible for designing, building, operating and maintaining components of the petabyte-scale platform that stores trillions of records and processes millions of new events every second, owning its reliability, performance and availability. Our stack is built using Golang, runs in Kubernetes, and is, of course, stored in ClickHouse. The team’s responsibilities include gathering and processing data for the internal billing and accounting system as well as customer-facing dashboards that provide our customers with immediate insights and analytics. The Product Metrics system is specifically designed to prioritize delivery guarantees, precision, and accuracy in handling extensive data volumes. Its primary goal is to provide data that is both prompt and accurate, supporting reliable operational decisions and enhancing the overall customer experience.

What will you do?

  • Take an active part in determining the roadmap for the Product Metrics team

  • Work closely within the team to deliver new features, iterate and improve them

  • Design, build, operate, and maintain business-critical petabyte-scale systems

  • Be responsible for the performance, reliability, availability and cost-efficiency of the Product Metrics systems

  • Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team

  • Be a part of on-call rotation and take ownership of the services you're running

What are we looking for in you?

  • You demonstrate a strong initiative and a preference for action, high level of responsibility, ownership and accountability

  • You prioritize customer needs, ensuring that our products are designed with the user in mind

  • You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively

  • You have a strong problem solving mindset and have solid production debugging skills

  • You have excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and across engineering teams in a fully remote environment

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, and see yourself as a partner with the business with the shared goal of moving the business forward

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of relevant software development industry experience building and operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems

  • 2+ years of software application development experience using Golang

  • Experience with at least one of the major Cloud Service Providers such as AWS, GCP or Azure

  • Experience with storing, shipping, and retrieving large volumes of data efficiently using technologies such as ClickHouse 

  • Experience with technologies such as Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, Temporal as well as infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with ClickHouse

  • Experience writing Kubernetes operators or controllers

  • Experience with Kafka streaming technology 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - (Canada-Remote)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the role

We are committed to providing our customers with reliable and secure services so we are expanding our central Site Reliability Engineering team. You will be responsible for building and leading processes to ensure the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance of our cloud infrastructure. You will collaborate with different teams like Control Plane, Data Plane, Core, Security, Support and Operations and guide them to design and implement scalable, secure, highly available and fault-tolerant distributed systems. You will also own the areas of incident management and response, post-mortem analysis including running blameless postmortems, and continuous improvement of our Cloud services. You will be leveraging your software engineering expertise to develop software platforms and tools to optimize the operational and engineering efficiencies of ClickHouse Cloud. This role is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on our elastic, limitless scale, high-performance ClickHouse Cloud.

What will you do?

  • Collaborate with various engineering teams in ClickHouse to design and implement scalable, secure, and highly available systems for ClickHouse.

  • Establish and manage service level objectives (SLOs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for ClickHouse Cloud.

  • Ensure all the infrastructure components in ClickHouse Cloud (including Data Plane, Control Plane,ClickHouse Core, etc) have monitoring and alerting in place to ensure timely detection and resolution of incidents.

  • Enhance and refine incident response processes and post-mortem analysis for any outages in ClickHouse Cloud including working with the support team to communicate to the impacted customers.

  • Continuously improve the reliability and performance of our ClickHouse services.

  • Plan, enable, and drive Chaos initiatives across Engineering teams, based upon internal priorities.

  • Manage on-call processes to respond to performance and reliability issues, and establish best practices for coordinating escalation to resolve issues and minimize downtime.

About you:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • At least 8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with Go and/or Python. 

  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Excellent understanding of distributed databases and SQL, particularly ClickHouse is a major plus.

  • Hands-on experience with container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes or Docker Swarm.

  • Strong experience with automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet.

  • You are a strong problem solver and have solid production debugging skills.

  • You are passionate about efficiency, availability, scalability, and data governance.

  • You thrive in a fast paced environment, and see yourself as a partner with the business with the shared goal of moving the business forward.

  • You have a high level of responsibility, ownership, and accountability.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

 

#LI-Remote
