jobs.title: シニア テクニカルサポートエンジニア — 日本（リモート、東京への出張あり）
jobs.descriptionHtml:
日本語訳

募集地域について
本ポジションは日本での採用です。オフィス勤務ではないため、日本国内であればお住まいの地域は問いません。渋谷(東京)にオフィスがあり、東京在住の方が望ましいですが、必須ではありません。

担当する業務
ClickHouseでは現在、世界中のお客様に優れたサービスを提供するサポートチームを拡大しています。日本国内のお客様はもちろん、APJおよびEMEA地域にまたがるお客様に関する幅広い業務に取り組んでいただける方を探しています。本ポジションはお客様と直接やり取りする職種で、日本国内でのお客様先への訪問も一部含まれます。サポートチケットやコミュニティサポートに加え、プリセールス・ポストセールス双方のお客様向け活動の支援、Go To Marketチームと連携したPOCの高度な技術面への対応、ClickHouseのサポート部門における業務改善の提案など、幅広い業務を主体的に担当していただきます。自ら率先して手を動かし、日本での地域プレゼンスの拡大に貢献したい方にとって、またとない機会です。

参画いただく可能性のあるプロジェクト例

  • サポートサービスチーム、エンジニアリング、プロダクトマネジメントと緊密に連携し、ユーザーやお客様に必要とされる機能の定義に貢献する

  • ClickHouse CloudおよびClickHouseオープンソースをベースとしたソリューションを開発し、ドキュメント、ナレッジベース、ブログ、ミートアップ、ウェビナー、トレーニングを通じて、ユーザー、コミュニティ、お客様と共有する

  • 同僚、ユーザー、お客様に対するメンタリングやトレーニング、知識の共有を支援する

そして、もちろん以下も担います

  • フロントラインのエンジニア、そしてClickHouseの代表として、優れたカスタマーサービスを提供します。当社のサポートエンジニアは、チケットシステム、メール、Slack、電話などで受け付けた技術的なケースに対し、所定のサービスレベルアグリーメント(「SLA」)の範囲内で、プロフェッショナルな対応、オンコール対応、およびガイダンスを提供します

  • 同僚、お客様、パートナーとの間に、強固で信頼できる関係を築きます

求めるスキル・経験

  • テクニカルサポート組織での実務経験

  • 関連分野における幅広く深い技術力(例:ClickHouse DBMS、または類似のOLAP/SQLデータベース、クラウド/SaaSプラットフォームの経験、Linux/Unixの経験、Kubernetesおよびコンテナの経験、システムまたはネットワーク管理の経験)

  • グローバルに分散した環境で高品質な24時間365日のサポートを提供するために必要な、勤務スケジュールおよび出張(現地訪問)に対応でき、対応可能であること

  • 日本語と英語の両方における優れた文章力・会話力

  • プリセールス・ポストセールスのサポート、ソリューションエンジニアリングまたはセールスエンジニアリング、コンサルティング、トレーニングなどを伴う、顧客対応職での経験

  • チームワーク、グローバルな視点での関わり、共感力、そして困難な課題を解決する姿勢

  • 世界で最もスケーラブルで、最高性能かつ最大規模、最速のデータベースを構築することに対する冒険心と切迫感

  • 自発的で好奇心旺盛、継続的に学び成長する意欲があること

  • ソフトウェア開発者、プロダクトマネージャー、アカウント担当者、ユーザーコミュニティと協力し、素晴らしいユーザー体験・顧客体験を実現した実績

jobs.title: Senior Technical Customer Support Engineer - Japan
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are hiring for this role in Japan. Your exact location within the country does not matter as the role is not office-based, but we do have an office in Shibuya, Tokyo. Being locared in Tokyo is preferred but not required.

What you will be doing:

We are currently growing our support team at ClickHouse who provides excellent service to our customers around the world. We hope to find you ready to take on a large variety of tasks related to our customers locally in Japan, as well as more regionally across APJ and EMEA. This is a customer-facing role that will include some onsite customer visits in Japan.  You will be owning a wide variety of tasks: from support tickets to community support, helping with both pre- and post-sales customer activities, partnering with our Go To Market team on deeply technical aspects of POCs, and suggesting improvements to how we do things in Support at ClickHouse. This is a great opportunity for someone ready to roll up their sleeves and help us expand our regional presence in Japan! 

Examples of projects you might contribute to:

  • Work closely with the Support Services team, Engineering, and Product Management to help define functionality required by users and customers

  • Develop solutions based on ClickHouse Cloud and ClickHouse open-source that can be shared with our users, community, and customers via documentation, knowledge base, blogs, meetups, webinars, and training

  • Assist with mentoring, training, and sharing your knowledge with colleagues, users, and customers 

And of course:

  • You will deliver excellent customer service as a front-line engineer and representative of ClickHouse. Our Support Engineers provide professional response, on-call coverage, and guidance within the required Service Level Agreement ("SLA") on technical cases that are opened via a ticketing system, email, Slack, and/or phone

  • You will build strong, trusted relationships with colleagues, customers, and partners

What you will bring along:

  • Prior experience within a technical support organization

  • Technical breadth and depth in relevant subjects, for example: ClickHouse DBMS or similar OLAP or SQL databases, experience with Cloud/SaaS platforms, Linux/Unix experience, experience with Kubernetes and containers, System or Network Administration experience

  • Be present and available according to the scheduling and onsite travel required to deliver high-quality 24x7 Support in a global, distributed environment

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Japanese and English

  • Experience in a customer-facing role that entailed pre- and post-sales support, solution or sales engineering, consulting, and/or training

  • A mindset of teamwork, global engagement, empathy, and solving challenging problems

  • A sense of adventure and urgency in building the most scalable, highest performing, largest, and fastest databases on the planet

  • Self-driven, curious, and eager to continuously learn and grow

Bonus points:

  • Passion for applying open-source software technology to massive data sets in order to solve complex questions and improve the world in which we live

Perks

jobs.title: Research Intern, ClickHouse Labs
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Program Overview

The ClickHouse PhD Research Internship Program offers doctoral students the opportunity to pursue ambitious research alongside ClickHouse Labs researchers and engineers working on some of the most interesting challenges in databases, systems, and data infrastructure.

Research interns join ClickHouse Labs for approximately 10-12 weeks to explore meaningful research questions, develop new ideas, and investigate technologies that have the potential to advance both the broader research community and the future of ClickHouse.

The program is intentionally designed around research collaboration. Interns are paired with experienced researchers and have the opportunity to pursue work that aligns with their academic interests, ongoing research, and areas of interest within ClickHouse Labs. In some cases, an internship may build on research, a prototype, or a system the student has already begun exploring at their university.

We believe the strongest research relationships extend beyond a single summer. Interns may continue their work after returning to their university through academic research, open-source contributions, publications, or other forms of collaboration. Where there is a strong mutual fit, an internship may become the beginning of a longer-term relationship between the researcher, ClickHouse Labs, and the broader academic community.

During their internship, researchers will have the opportunity to work closely with ClickHouse Labs, engage with ClickHouse's open-source technology and engineering community, share their findings, and contribute to the intellectual life of the broader research community.

Program length: 10-12 weeks, with flexibility based on academic calendars and research needs

Typical timing: Summer, beginning approximately June 1

Locations: Opportunities available across the US and Europe, subject to role and employment requirements. Remote first.

Research environment: ClickHouse Labs

Internship format: Research-focused, mentor-supported, and shaped around areas of mutual research interest

Compensation: commensurate with experience, a monthly stipend will be paid

Research at ClickHouse Labs

ClickHouse Labs explores ambitious ideas at the intersection of databases, distributed systems, data infrastructure, and the broader systems research community.

We believe some of the most interesting advances in these areas happen through close collaboration between industry and academia. ClickHouse Labs brings together researchers and engineers to explore new ideas, investigate challenging technical problems, and connect academic research with real-world systems at scale.

Research interns are an important part of that community. Interns have the opportunity to bring their own research interests and perspectives into ClickHouse Labs while working alongside researchers and engineers who are deeply engaged with both the practical challenges and open research questions shaping the future of data systems.

Program Goals

  1. Identify exceptional PhD researchers working in areas directly relevant to ClickHouse.

  2. Give researchers the opportunity to work on meaningful, open-ended problems with ClickHouse Labs.

  3. Build long-term relationships with researchers and academic institutions.

  4. Encourage continued research and open-source contributions after the internship.

  5. Create opportunities for co-authored papers, thesis advising, or other academic collaboration.

  6. Increase ClickHouse's visibility within the database and systems research community.

  7. Publish and share meaningful research outcomes through the ClickHouse website and other appropriate channels.

What Makes the Program Different

This is intentionally not a highly structured engineering internship and should not detailed planning. ****But the high-level problem area and expectations should defined several months before the internship begins. This flexibility is intentional and allows ClickHouse Labs to respond to:

  • Emerging research questions

  • Current ClickHouse priorities

  • New academic research

  • Interesting systems or database prototypes

  • Work candidates have already completed

  • Opportunities to apply new research ideas to ClickHouse

The goal is to identify researchers whose work is already closely aligned with areas ClickHouse cares about and then determine the most valuable research problem to pursue together.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for exceptional PhD students conducting research directly relevant to ClickHouse and the broader database/systems space.

Ideal candidates

  • Currently pursuing a PhD in computer science or a closely related field

  • Conducting research in areas relevant to ClickHouse

  • Demonstrated research excellence

  • Strong database systems, distributed systems, hardware, or related technical background

  • Has demonstrated ability to independently pursue complex research questions

  • Ideally has prior experience with ClickHouse open source but not required**.**

  • Has research, prototypes, or publications that could translate into meaningful work with ClickHouse

  • Interested in continuing research beyond the internship

  • Potential interest in open-source contribution and academic collaboration

Candidate Selection Philosophy

The strongest candidates will be researchers whose work is specifically relevant to what ClickHouse Labs wants to explore.

A candidate who has already:

  • Worked with ClickHouse

  • Built a relevant database or systems prototype

  • Published research in an area relevant to ClickHouse

  • Explored a technical problem ClickHouse is interested in

may be significantly more valuable than a candidate with an otherwise impressive academic profile but no meaningful connection to our research areas.

Research Areas & Project Scope

Unlike an engineering internship program, specific projects do not need to be defined when recruiting begins.

Research projects may emerge from:

  • A candidate's existing research

  • A recent academic paper

  • A prototype or system the candidate has developed

  • An emerging ClickHouse Labs research priority

  • An opportunity to test or extend an existing research concept within ClickHouse

If this is relevant and exciting to you, please apply!

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Database Research Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse Labs is an applied research group that works closely with engineering teams to identify challenging problems in database systems and develop novel solutions. Our goal is to advance the state of the art and translate research ideas into real-world system improvements.

About the Role

As a Research Scientist at ClickHouse Labs, you will work on high-impact problems at the intersection of database systems, distributed systems, AI, and systems software engineering while collaborating with experienced researchers and engineers. The role covers a broad range of problems across database systems research and engineering, including but not limited to query optimization, execution engines, distributed systems, consensus protocols, materialized views, indexing and data structures, benchmarking, workload analysis, and emerging agentic workloads.

In this role, you will work on leading open-source database systems (e.g., ClickHouse, PostgreSQL). You will investigate performance and scalability bottlenecks in production-quality systems, develop new algorithms and system designs, and evaluate them under realistic workloads and hardware configurations. Projects may involve improving query planning and execution, reducing CPU and memory overhead, increasing throughput and concurrency, scaling across distributed deployments, or redesigning system components to leverage modern hardware better. You will work closely with engineers to turn successful ideas into robust implementations that can be deployed and maintained in widely used open-source systems.

Researchers are encouraged to publish their work, contribute to open-source projects, participate in leading research conferences, and pursue ambitious projects with strong engineering and research support.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct applied research aimed at advancing the performance, scalability, reliability, and functionality of open-source database management systems, including ClickHouse and PostgreSQL.

  • Develop high-quality research prototypes and production-grade implementations, and work with engineering teams to integrate successful techniques into open-source and production systems.

  • Collaborate closely with database engine, infrastructure, and data-plane engineers to identify high-impact research problems and translate research results into practical system improvements.

  • Analyze large-scale database workloads, performance traces, benchmarks, and production telemetry to identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.

  • Design rigorous experiments and benchmarks to evaluate new techniques across realistic workloads, hardware configurations, and deployment environments.

  • Communicate research results through technical reports, open-source contributions, internal presentations, and publications at leading database and systems venues (e.g., SIGMOD, VLDB, CIDR).

  • Contribute to the broader technical direction of ClickHouse Labs by identifying emerging research opportunities and helping shape longer-term research projects.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Masters/Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, with research experience in databases, distributed systems, systems software, or machine learning systems.

  • Strong publication record in leading peer-reviewed research venues such as SIGMOD, VLDB, SOSP, OSDI, NSDI, or NeurIPS, with work relevant to databases or systems.

  • Strong programming and systems-development background, including experience working with database internals or other large systems codebases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, or comparable modern DBMSs.

  • Proficiency in systems programming using C, C++, Rust, Zig, or a comparable low-level programming language.

  • Strong analytical, experimental, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing or operating database systems in cloud environments such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure.

  • Familiarity with large language models, reinforcement learning, learned optimization, or other techniques at the intersection of machine learning and systems.

  • Experience contributing to large open-source systems projects, particularly database engines, distributed systems, compilers, or storage systems.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Familiarity with modern systems-development and verification tooling, including formal specification or model-checking frameworks such as TLA+/PlusCal, Alloy, or Lean, as well as relevant development tools and languages such as LLVM, eBPF, Python, Go, or advanced profiling and debugging tools (e.g., perf, sanitizers, or tracing frameworks).

  • Proven track record in optimizing database systems via hardware acceleration (e.g., GPU, FPGA, CXL), with a focus on designing methods for offloading for query execution, storage layers, and data-intensive primitives using frameworks like CUDA, SYCL, ROCm, or specialized FPGA development flows.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing, Langfuse
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Langfuse

Langfuse is the open-source LLM engineering platform that helps teams build useful AI applications through tracing, evaluation, prompt management, datasets, and metrics. We are now part of ClickHouse. Like ClickHouse, Langfuse is open source, and we work in public: our product, docs, changelog, roadmap, and community discussions are visible to the developers and teams who use us. Langfuse is already one of the most widely adopted platforms in the category: trusted by 19 of the Fortune 50 and 63 of the Fortune 500, with 50M+ SDK installs per month, 6M+ Docker pulls, and 30k+ GitHub stars.

We are hiring a Head of Marketing for Langfuse.

This is a hands-on marketing leadership role for someone with deep experience in product marketing, developer marketing, and technical content. You will own how Langfuse shows up in the market, manage the Langfuse marketing team, and turn our current founder-led, product-led motion into a holistic marketing ecosystem.

The core of the role is still product marketing and developer trust: positioning, launches, category narrative, developer content, website, customer proof, lifecycle, funnel, sales enablement, and the way we explain Langfuse to technical users and technical buyers. At the same time, Langfuse now has access to ClickHouse's global go-to-market engine. You will be the person who makes those resources work for Langfuse without diluting the Langfuse voice.

What You'll Do:

  • Own Langfuse marketing strategy and execution globally, with product marketing and developer content as the center of gravity.

  • Manage and develop the Langfuse marketing team, including Product Marketing Engineering, Developer Advocacy, and Product Marketing content and resources.

  • Define the operating model for Langfuse marketing: what sits in the Langfuse pod, what runs through ClickHouse shared teams, who owns what, and how we measure whether it is working.

  • Build the marketing plan across positioning, launches, website narrative including product pages and conversion paths, customer proof, onboarding, lifecycle, funnel, sales collateral, campaigns, and events.

  • Own the Langfuse category narrative: LLM observability, evals, prompt management, datasets, agent observability, self-hosting, and the broader LLM engineering workflow.

  • Keep the developer motion strong: useful technical content, examples, cookbooks, docs-adjacent education, changelog, town halls, open-source communication, and high-trust product launches.

  • Partner with ClickHouse demand generation and field marketing to make enterprise marketing systematic rather than ad hoc: webinars, workshops, regional events, conferences, paid campaigns, retargeting, and follow-up motions.

  • Create the canonical Langfuse sales narrative and enablement system so ClickHouse AEs, SAs, field teams, and leadership can confidently explain Langfuse.

  • Lead customer marketing and proof: case studies, technical stories, customer references, logo strategy, community stories, enterprise migration stories, and reusable sales narratives.

  • Use data to run the function: unique visitors, signups, activation, revenue, product usage signals, campaign performance, attribution, event ROI, pipeline creation, pipeline acceleration, and qualitative user feedback.

What You Bring Along:

  • You have led product marketing, developer marketing, DevRel, growth, or demand gen marketing for a technical SaaS product.

  • You have marketed to developers, infrastructure teams, AI teams, data teams, security teams, observability teams, or another highly technical audience.

  • You are a strong product marketer at the core: positioning, narrative, launch strategy, competitive thinking, customer proof, sales enablement, and technical buyer messaging are natural territory for you.

  • You write exceptionally well. You can make complex technical ideas clear without making them shallow.

  • You are technical enough to use the product, understand the market, earn credibility with engineers, and spot vague or misleading marketing.

  • You understand product-led growth and open-source funnels: activation, onboarding, conversion, lifecycle, self-serve adoption, usage signals, and sales-assisted expansion.

  • You understand enterprise marketing enough to work with demand gen, field marketing, sales, solutions, and regional teams. You do not need to personally run every event or paid campaign, but you need to know what good looks like and how to make the system work.

  • You can manage a small, high-talent team while remaining hands-on where the work needs senior judgment.

  • You are comfortable building the function while the company is changing around you. Some work will be cleanly owned. Some work will require influence, coordination, and judgment across a larger organization.

  • You already create content: blog posts, talks, product explainers, social posts, newsletters, videos, docs, demos, or open-source examples.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Cloud
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Product Manager on the Cloud team at ClickHouse, you will be responsible for leading the development and delivery of Cloud-focused features for our flagship offering. Potential areas of focus include the ClickHouse Cloud query experience, data visualization, and Cloud-native enhancements to the core product.

You will work closely with the design and engineering teams to ensure that each feature contributes to an intuitive, cohesive product experience, and is built to meet the needs of our customers. You will also collaborate with the marketing and sales teams to ensure that the product is effectively positioned and promoted in the market.

The Role:

Feature Ideation, Definition, and Development

  • Define and drive development of existing initiatives comprising the product roadmap for ClickHouse Cloud.

  • Be responsible for ensuring that these initiatives are delivered such that they align with our company goals and meet customer needs.

  • Conduct market research and gather customer feedback to inform priorities, and help manage the product backlog to ensure that the most valuable features and enhancements are prioritized and delivered in a timely manner. Prioritization is key.

  • Feel strongly about a feature that hasn’t yet been considered? No problem. This role benefits from high degrees of both autonomy and impact—you will be empowered to ideate and propose net-new initiatives, thereby contributing directly to our overall product strategy and direction.

Cross-functional Leadership and Collaboration

  • Every project requires collaboration between various teams at ClickHouse and you are the glue that holds them together. You will be responsible for coordinating with partners on the design, engineering, and security teams to ensure that they are aligned on scope and timeline for each project. You will also be principally in-charge of identifying, communicating, and resolving cross-team blockers and dependencies.

  • You will be the internal ‘face’ of your projects.

    • Pre-shipment, you will deliver periodic status updates to our leadership team and the broader company. You will also collaborate with our marketing and sales teams to develop and execute on feature launch strategy (documentation, positioning, messaging, pricing). Finally, you will conduct pre-launch enablement sessions for our sales and support teams, such that they are equipped to convey this information to our customers.

    • Post-shipment, you will maintain internal and external documentation and help our sales and support teams address customer questions, concerns, and feedback.

Performance Monitoring and Incremental Improvement

  • You will define, track, and own key performance indicators (KPIs) for your projects and regularly report on progress to stakeholders.

  • We ship incremental improvements across our product surface area every single week. You will obsessively monitor and analyze product usage and performance data to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

  • Relatedly, a crucial underpinning of any successful product is polish—nobody likes papercuts. You will dog-food our product on a daily basis and suggest incremental improvements that reduce jagged edges and contribute to a polished product experience.

You Bring:

  • 3+ years of cloud software engineering or related technical experience

  • Experience working with SQL databases and data analytics (prior experience with ClickHouse preferred but not required)

  • Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality products to market.

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to use data to inform product decisions.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate others to achieve goals.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Security
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with a strong background in security to join our dynamic team. This role will be crucial in defining and executing the product strategy for our security offerings, ensuring our products are robust, reliable, and secure, and that they meet the evolving needs of our customers. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of database security, networking, and identity management, and will be adept at navigating the complexities of product development from conception to launch.

What you will do:

  • Define and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for security-focused features and products.

  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer feedback sessions to identify opportunities and inform product decisions.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams to deliver high-quality, secure products.

  • Translate complex security requirements into clear, concise product specifications and user stories.

  • Prioritize product backlog and manage trade-offs to optimize for business value and customer satisfaction.

  • Drive product launch activities, including go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, and user documentation.

  • Monitor product performance, gather insights, and iterate on product features based on data and user feedback.

  • Act as a subject matter expert for security within the organization, providing guidance and insights to various stakeholders.

About You:

  • Minimum of 8+ years of experience in product management in B2B SaaS, with a significant focus on security products or features.

  • Proven experience with database security principles and best practices.

  • Strong understanding of networking concepts and their implications for security.

  • In-depth knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) topics.

  • Certifications in security (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+).

  • Demonstrated experience in quality assurance processes and methodologies.

  • Solid background in program management, including planning, execution, and risk management.

  • Prior experience in security engineering is required.

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience securing a data platform, database product, or real-time analytics service.

  • Familiarity with ClickHouse or other databases such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.

  • Experience supporting BYOC or private deployment models.

  • Background working with open source software or developer-focused products.

Perks

  • Go deep on database security, networking, and identity and access management (IAM) - enough to argue the details with engineering, not just approve what they propose.

  • Partner closely with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to ship products that are actually secure, not just marketed that way.

  • Translate complex security requirements into specifications and user stories that engineering can understand.

  • Own backlog prioritization and the trade-offs that come with it, weighing business value, customer risk, and engineering cost.

  • Drive go-to-market for security launches - positioning, sales enablement, documentation.

  • Monitor how security features perform in the real world and use that data, not just instinct, to decide what to build next.

  • Be the security subject-matter expert other teams come to, and provide guidance and coaching to PMs working on security-adjacent problems elsewhere in the org.

  • Represent our security posture and roadmap externally - with top customers, prospects, and analysts when the conversation needs someone who actually understands the tradeoffs.

jobs.title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is hiring its first Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own how we engage, activate, and grow our user base across the entire customer journey. Your mission is to turn Cloud signups, trial users, and prospects into pipeline and self-serve MRR through behavior-driven lifecycle programs across email and in-product channels. You'll design the nurture engine that powers both our PLG and sales-led motions.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will build from the ground up as the first lifecycle marketer at ClickHouse, try new marketing strategies, and work with a passionate community of ClickHouse users.


What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the lifecycle marketing strategy end-to-end, from Cloud signup onboarding through activation, conversion and expansion, with accountability for trial-to-paid conversion, MQL volume, and influenced pipeline.

  • Build behavior-triggered nurture programs that respond to product usage, content engagement, and intent signals, so the right message reaches the right user at the right stage.

  • Design and optimize onboarding journeys for ClickHouse Cloud signups, partnering with Growth PMs and the product team to align email touchpoints with in-product experiences and drive activation.

  • Run always-on nurture for the sales-led funnel, with segmented streams by persona, use case, and funnel stage that warm prospects for sales and accelerate open opportunities.

  • Build and run a testing roadmap across subject lines, send cadence, content formats, and channel mix, using results to improve engagement and conversion.

  • Report on lifecycle funnel metrics for PLG and SLG, analyze conversion at each stage, identify drop-off points, and implement improvements.

  • Track industry trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to identify new lifecycle opportunities.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years owning lifecycle, email, or growth marketing programs (onboarding, activation, nurture, retention). Years can be combined across roles.

  • At least 3 years at a database, data infrastructure, developer tooling, or API company, or another technical product sold to developers or data practitioners.

  • Proven track record of building behavior-triggered lifecycle programs that measurably improved activation, conversion, and pipeline at a PLG company with a free trial, free tier, or self-serve signup.

  • Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, run experiments, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to create engaging content for developers and to work closely with engineers and product partners.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously and meet deadlines.

  • Preferred: experience at a company with an open-source product.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

jobs.title: People Business Partner Lead, EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is hiring an EMEA People Business Partner Lead to be the primary strategic People partner to business leaders across the region. By combining deep business partnership, organizational insight, and proactive People strategy, this role will help shape how the EMEA organization evolves—not simply respond to the needs of the business as they arise.

This role is responsible for deeply understanding the business, its growth strategy, and the unique dynamics across EMEA, and translating that understanding into proactive People and organizational strategy. You will help leaders anticipate needs, spot risks and opportunities, and build the teams, leadership capability, and practices required to scale.

In this role, you will help leaders anticipate organizational needs and identify risks and opportunities, while enabling them with the leadership capability and people practices needed to scale their teams successfully.

Success in this role requires strong business acumen, organizational judgment, and the ability to move beyond responding to leadership requests to independently identifying what the business needs. Because EMEA is a diverse and complex region, this person must be able to understand the different business and market dynamics across countries while maintaining a cohesive view of the region and its long-term organizational needs.

What You’ll Do

Strategic People & Business Partnership

  • Serve as the primary People partner to our managers and leaders based in EMEA, deeply understanding their growth strategy, operating model, and organizational dynamics.

  • Translate business priorities into proactive People and organizational strategies, bringing an independent point of view and identifying risks and opportunities early.

  • Partner with leaders on complex organizational decisions and ensure People is embedded early in business planning.

Organizational Strategy & Effectiveness

  • Partner with EMEA leadership on organizational design, workforce planning, role clarity, team effectiveness, and leadership capability.

  • Identify patterns and systemic issues across teams and translate insights into recommendations and action.

  • Use workforce, talent, and organizational data to inform performance, talent, succession, and organizational decisions.

People Strategy & Program Leadership

  • Partner with global People teams to adapt programs for regional needs and identify gaps or opportunities for improvement.

  • Drive adoption and effectiveness of People initiatives, bringing regional insights back to the global People organization.

Global Partnership & Influence

  • Serve as the strategic People partner to leaders navigating complex employee and organizational situations across EMEA.

  • Partner with People Operations and Legal to navigate performance, conduct, organizational change, and other complex people matters.

  • Identify patterns and proactively address broader organizational or leadership issues.

  • Bridge EMEA leadership and the global People organization, ensuring regional needs inform company-wide People strategy.

  • Partner across People, Finance, Recruiting, Compensation, Legal, and other functions to align organizational and talent priorities with business needs.

  • Influence across geographies and functions in a global, distributed environment.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in senior HR Business Partner or People leadership roles, ideally supporting complex, high-growth businesses across EMEA.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop a deep understanding of a business and translate business strategy into proactive People and organizational strategy.

  • Strong experience in organizational design, workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, talent strategy, and leadership partnership.

  • Proven ability to influence senior business leaders and bring an independent, well-informed point of view to complex decisions.

  • Demonstrated pattern recognition and judgment, with the ability to identify organizational risks and opportunities before they become visible problems.

  • Experience developing or adapting People programs to meet business needs and driving adoption and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong business acumen and curiosity, with a genuine interest in understanding how the business operates and what drives success.

  • Experience working across global and distributed organizations, ideally with exposure to the complexity and diversity of EMEA markets.

  • Strong relationship-building and influence skills across cultures, functions, and geographies.

  • Comfortable operating independently in ambiguity and creating direction within their scope rather than waiting for direction.

#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Head of Regional Marketing, APJ
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As Head of Regional Marketing, APJ, you will lead ClickHouse's regional marketing strategy across APJ, building awareness, generating pipeline, and accelerating revenue. You will build and lead the regional marketing team while partnering closely with APJ sales leadership as part of the go-to-market team, and adapt global campaigns to the distinct needs of markets across the region. You will be measured on enterprise pipeline and self-service revenue (MRR), working across both our self-serve, product-led motion and our sales-led enterprise motion.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the APJ regional marketing strategy, annual plan, and budget, aligning field programs to regional pipeline and revenue targets in partnership with sales leadership.

  • Build, lead, coach, and grow a team of regional marketers, setting clear goals, developing talent, and building a high-performance culture.

  • Serve as the marketing counterpart to APJ sales leadership, participating in regional forecasting, QBRs, and account planning so marketing investment maps to sales priorities.

  • Partner with growth and demand generation to support the commercial sales team's product-led motion, converting self-serve usage into commercial pipeline and expansion revenue.

  • Develop an integrated regional program mix spanning first-party hosted events, third-party conferences, virtual events, ABM plays, digital advertising, and partner marketing.

  • Adapt global campaigns, messaging, and content for APJ markets, and establish scalable processes for campaign planning, lead management, and follow-up with marketing operations and global demand generation, so every program has a clear path from engagement to pipeline.

  • Track, analyze, and report on regional marketing performance, including pipeline generated and influenced revenue.

  • Identify emerging market opportunities across APJ, making the case for new investments in geographies, verticals, or channels, and represent the region in global planning cycles.

What You Bring Along

  • 10+ years of experience in field, regional, or integrated marketing within the database, data analytics, infrastructure, or developer tooling space

  • Deep experience marketing across APJ markets

  • Demonstrated success owning a pipeline number and driving measurable revenue impact through regional marketing programs

  • Proven ability to partner with sales leadership at the VP level

  • Experience working in a remote-first, globally distributed organization, with the ability to collaborate across time zones

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

Perks

jobs.title: Head of Story & Communications
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse has a lot worth saying. The database has become a platform for real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads. Many of the most interesting AI and software companies of the last few years run on it. Our founders and leaders hold clear, well-formed views on where data and AI are heading. And every week the customer base produces proof points most companies would build a campaign around. What we have not yet built is the function whose job it is to turn all of that into one story the market hears consistently, and from us.

We are looking for a Head of Story & Communications to build that function from the ground up. You'll own the company narrative: what ClickHouse should be known for, how the platform story gets told above the level of features, and how the proof we generate adds up to a thesis. And you'll build the machine that carries it into the world: the announcement calendar, press and media relationships across technology and business media, and executive platforms for our founders and leaders. This is a build role and a player-coach role. You won't inherit a team; you'll hire one as the function grows, directing our agency partners in the meantime and staying in the work yourself. You'll report to the VP of Global Marketing and work closely with the executive team, product marketing, and the people closest to our customers.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Define what ClickHouse should be known for and turn it into a rolling narrative and communications strategy that the marketing and executive teams work from

  • Lead the communications function: set its priorities, operating model, and investment decisions, own its budget, and hold it accountable for results

  • Build the communications machine: announcement calendar and tiering, press materials, holding statements, a reporter cadence, and launch amplification, directing agency partners and holding them to outcomes

  • Own press and media relations across technology and business media, taking the ClickHouse story beyond the tech press and re-educating the market on the full platform

  • Build executive platforms for our founders and leaders: the themes each owns, the moments and formats worth their time, and a clear way to evaluate inbound podcast, mainstage, and sponsored event opportunities

  • Shape quarterly release moments and major launches so they earn attention and show up consistently across press, social, community, and the field

  • Set the standard for how ClickHouse sounds in public: voice, quality bar, and the discipline that every published claim, number, and proof point is approved, current, and consistent

  • Hire and lead the team as the function grows, and build the planning and review rhythm that keeps narrative, communications, and social aligned

What You Bring Along

  • Experience building or rebuilding a communications function at a growth-stage infrastructure, developer, or data company

  • Experience hiring, managing, and developing communications team members

  • Experience owning a communications budget and directing agencies to outcomes, with judgment about what belongs in-house

  • A record of landing stories in tier-one business media as well as technology press, with the relationships and news judgment to do it again

  • Experience working directly with a CEO and executive team: shaping their points of view, preparing them, and declining opportunities not worth their time

  • Media-company operator instincts: you think in themes, arcs, and audiences

  • Player-coach approach: you write and edit yourself, give useful feedback, and set the bar by example

  • Comfort with a technical product and a technical audience, including credibility with engineers and developers

  • Experience directing agencies to outcomes, with judgment about what belongs in-house

  • Analytical grounding: you track what is landing, form a view on why, and use it to decide where to focus

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Core Engineering (Security Features)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is focused on growing a vibrant user community and becoming a Cloud-first

company. We are looking for a Product Manager experienced in developing security features for ClickHouse. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a popular open-source project to extend

and deepen its core capabilities and to develop cloud-native extensions that delight developers

and data analysts across many use cases and market segments. If you are a doer with a “can

do” mentality and a bias for action, we would love to hear from you.

What you will be doing:

  • Understand the real-time analytics and cloud database markets, competition, and technology trends in depth

  • Engage with the ClickHouse open-source user community and ClickHouse Cloud customers to understand current and aspirational use cases for ClickHouse core database

  • Distill and prioritize feature requests and issues into clear priorities for net-new capabilities and improvements

  • Work with engineering teams to scope and refine approaches to solving customer problems, both in the core database and in ClickHouse Cloud offerings

  • Set clear measurable goals around customer success, and use data-driven approaches to ensure new capabilities meet customer needs

  • Stay up-to-date on the state of the market and competitive landscape to identify needed features and areas of improvement for ClickHouse that align with the roadmap and general requests received by our community and customers

  • Work with partners to grow ClickHouse awareness and visibility

What you bring along:

  • Proven experience with database security principles and best practices

  • Knowledgeable and passionate about data engineering markets - data warehousing, data analytics, security, and observability

  • Strong vision around where these markets are headed, and what it takes to become a leader in this space

  • Previous experience with ClickHouse or a highly related OLAP technology at a deeply technical level

  • Previous experience with open-source projects, ideally as a product manager

  • Passionate about building enterprise capabilities that are powerful yet easy to use

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to influence multiple stakeholders without direct authority

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving based on business needs

  • Ability and desire to work with customers or community members, providing technical guidance and support during their POC.

Bonus Points for:

  • Previous contributions to open-source projects

  • Engineering experience, ideally around distributed/cloud systems in C++

  • Experience effectively working remotely in a global, distributed organization

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Typescript / Frontend) - AI/ML
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

The AI/ML Engineering team builds and operates ClickHouse's AI and machine learning products end-to-end. This includes the Agentic Data Stack, AI Functions, chDB, the in-Console copilot, and the AI/ML partnerships that distribute them — together with the shared components and expertise that let every other ClickHouse team ship AI in the surfaces they own. Our team is looking for highly skilled and experienced software engineers to join us, who will be responsible for designing, building, and operating the products that make ClickHouse the platform of choice for agents and data scientists.

What you will do

  • Feature Development: Design and implement AI-powered features across the full stack, from backend inference services to intuitive frontend interfaces within the ClickHouse Cloud platform.

  • API Architecture: Create robust, scalable APIs that connect ClickHouse's database capabilities with modern AI/ML inference systems and external/internal AI services.

  • Ecosystem Integrations: Implement and maintain integrations with the broader AI/ML ecosystem and standards, ensuring that ClickHouse as a technology works seamlessly with popular frameworks and tools.

  • Technical Integration: Integrate models into production systems with proper monitoring, versioning, observability, and evaluation.

  • Oncall: Participate in the daytime oncall rotation along with the rest of the team.

  • UI/UX Implementation: Build responsive, intuitive user interfaces that make complex AI functionalities accessible and valuable to users of all technical backgrounds.

What you will bring along

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in production environments

  • Exposure to working directly with AI/ML technologies

  • A high level of ownership and can drive features from concept to production with minimal supervision

  • Ability to thrive in collaborative environments and can effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders

  • Strong frontend skills with TypeScript/JavaScript and React

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating and deploying AI/ML models in production systems, including working with inference APIs and vector databases

  • Familiarity with cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, particularly services related to AI/ML deployment

  • Understanding of database systems and data processing pipelines, with ClickHouse experience being a significant plus

  • Experience building data-oriented interfaces and visualizations

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - (EMEA-Remote)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the role

We are committed to providing our customers with reliable and secure services so we are expanding our central Site Reliability Engineering team. You will be responsible for building and leading processes to ensure the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance of our cloud infrastructure. You will collaborate with different teams like Control Plane, Data Plane, Core, Security, Support and Operations and guide them to design and implement scalable, secure, highly available and fault-tolerant distributed systems. You will also own the areas of incident management and response, post-mortem analysis including running blameless postmortems, and continuous improvement of our Cloud services. You will be leveraging your software engineering expertise to develop software platforms and tools to optimize the operational and engineering efficiencies of ClickHouse Cloud. This role is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on our elastic, limitless scale, high-performance ClickHouse Cloud.

What will you do?

  • Collaborate with various engineering teams in ClickHouse to design and implement scalable, secure, and highly available systems for ClickHouse.

  • Establish and manage service level objectives (SLOs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for ClickHouse Cloud.

  • Ensure all the infrastructure components in ClickHouse Cloud (including Data Plane, Control Plane,ClickHouse Core, etc) have monitoring and alerting in place to ensure timely detection and resolution of incidents.

  • Enhance and refine incident response processes and post-mortem analysis for any outages in ClickHouse Cloud including working with the support team to communicate to the impacted customers.

  • Continuously improve the reliability and performance of our ClickHouse services.

  • Plan, enable, and drive Chaos initiatives across Engineering teams, based upon internal priorities.

  • Manage on-call processes to respond to performance and reliability issues, and establish best practices for coordinating escalation to resolve issues and minimize downtime.

About you:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • At least 8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with Go and/or Python. 

  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Excellent understanding of distributed databases and SQL, particularly ClickHouse is a major plus.

  • Hands-on experience with container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes or Docker Swarm.

  • Strong experience with automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet.

  • You are a strong problem solver and have solid production debugging skills.

  • You are passionate about efficiency, availability, scalability, and data governance.

  • You thrive in a fast paced environment, and see yourself as a partner with the business with the shared goal of moving the business forward.

  • You have a high level of responsibility, ownership, and accountability.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (AI/ML)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 3,000 customers and ARR that has grown over 250 percent year over year, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

The company’s sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

We’re on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

About the team

The AI/ML Engineering team builds and operates ClickHouse's AI and machine learning products end-to-end. This includes the Agentic Data Stack, AI Functions, chDB, the in-Console copilot, and the AI/ML partnerships that distribute them — together with the shared components and expertise that let every other ClickHouse team ship AI in the surfaces they own. Our team is looking for highly skilled and experienced software engineers to join us, who will be responsible for designing, building, and operating the products that make ClickHouse the platform of choice for agents and data scientists.

What you will do

  • Feature Development: Design and implement AI-powered features across the full stack, from backend inference services to intuitive frontend interfaces within the ClickHouse Cloud platform.

  • API Architecture: Create robust, scalable APIs that connect ClickHouse's database capabilities with modern AI/ML inference systems and external/internal AI services.

  • Ecosystem Integrations: Implement and maintain integrations with the broader AI/ML ecosystem and standards, ensuring that ClickHouse as a technology works seamlessly with popular frameworks and tools.

  • Technical Integration: Integrate models into production systems with proper monitoring, versioning, observability, and evaluation.

  • Oncall: Participate in the daytime oncall rotation along with the rest of the team.

  • ML Engineering: Own the ML pipeline end to end (data, training, evaluation), and fine-tune or train custom models when off-the-shelf ones fall short. Track the state of the art closely enough to apply what genuinely improves our products.

What you will bring along

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in production environments

  • Exposure to working directly with AI/ML technologies

  • Experience integrating and deploying AI/ML models in production systems, including working with inference APIs and vector databases

  • A high level of ownership and can drive features from concept to production with minimal supervision

  • Ability to thrive in collaborative environments and can effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders

  • Applied ML experience in Python (Jupyter, PyTorch, common ML libraries), hands-on with compute clusters (Ray, Slurm), and designs trustworthy experiments to drive architectural decisions

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, particularly services related to AI/ML deployment

  • Understanding of database systems and data processing pipelines, with ClickHouse experience being a significant plus

  • Experience with embedding-based systems (retrieval, ranking, recommenders) and the representation-learning ideas underneath them

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager, UK & Ireland (London)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is hiring a Senior Field Marketing Manager to build our field presence across the UK and Ireland. This is our first dedicated marketing hire for the region, and a foundational role. You’ll own the regional strategy, choose the events worth investing in, and run them end to end, with a direct line from your work to pipeline and new signups.

You’ll report to the Head of Regional Marketing, EMEA, and work closely with sales, product marketing, developer advocacy, engineering and product. ClickHouse sits where open source meets enterprise, so your events need to earn the trust of technical users and also move enterprise accounts forward.

What you’ll do

  • Build and run the UKI event strategy across hosted events, trade shows, conferences and webinars, from planning and contracts through on-site execution and follow-up.

  • Turn demand generation plans into events that fill rooms with the right accounts and give sales something real to follow up on.

  • Plan pre- and post-event plays with sales so every event connects to pipeline.

  • Lead our Fulham FC sponsorship activity locally, including C-level experiences and occasional weekend coverage on home match days, and co-host events with partners.

  • Run account-based, multi-channel campaigns aimed at key enterprise accounts in the region.

  • Measure what works, report on pipeline and attendance, and change course when the data says so.

  • Maintain the UKI event calendar and spot new opportunities.

  • Work with an events agency on production so your time goes to strategy and the moments that matter.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in field, event or regional marketing at a B2B SaaS company, running events end to end at small and large scale.

  • Field marketing experience in the UK and Ireland market.

  • Account-based marketing experience, including multi-channel regional campaigns and engaging C-level audiences.

  • A track record of driving pipeline and awareness, with measurable campaign reporting.

  • A close working relationship with sales teams on objectives, messaging and execution.

  • Comfort working independently in a remote-first, fast-moving environment.

  • Based in London, or within about an hour of it.

  • Willingness to travel across EMEA more than 15% of the time.

Nice to have

  • Experience in databases, data analytics, data platforms or cybersecurity. If you’re a strong field marketer from another technical space, we’d still like to hear from you.

  • Experience with sponsorship or co-hosted partner events.

  • Experience marketing to developers or open source communities.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Recognised on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 3,000 customers and ARR that has grown over 250 percent year over year, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

The company’s sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

We’re on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

About the team

The AI/ML Engineering team builds and operates ClickHouse's AI and machine learning products end-to-end. This includes the Agentic Data Stack, AI Functions, chDB, the in-Console copilot, and the AI/ML partnerships that distribute them — together with the shared components and expertise that let every other ClickHouse team ship AI in the surfaces they own. Our team is looking for highly skilled and experienced software engineers to join us, who will be responsible for designing, building, and operating the products that make ClickHouse the platform of choice for agents and data scientists.

 

What you will do

  • Feature Development: Design and implement AI-powered features across the full stack, from backend inference services to intuitive frontend interfaces within the ClickHouse Cloud platform.

  • API Architecture: Create robust, scalable APIs that connect ClickHouse's database capabilities with modern AI/ML inference systems and external/internal AI services.

  • Ecosystem Integrations: Implement and maintain integrations with the broader AI/ML ecosystem and standards, ensuring that ClickHouse as a technology works seamlessly with popular frameworks and tools.

  • Technical Integration: Integrate models into production systems with proper monitoring, versioning, observability, and evaluation.

  • Oncall: Participate in the daytime oncall rotation along with the rest of the team.

  • ML Engineering: Own the ML pipeline end to end (data, training, evaluation), and fine-tune or train custom models when off-the-shelf ones fall short. Track the state of the art closely enough to apply what genuinely improves our products.

What you will bring along

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in production environments

  • Exposure to working directly with AI/ML technologies

  • Experience integrating and deploying AI/ML models in production systems, including working with inference APIs and vector databases

  • A high level of ownership and can drive features from concept to production with minimal supervision

  • Ability to thrive in collaborative environments and can effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders

  • Applied ML experience in Python (Jupyter, PyTorch, common ML libraries), hands-on with compute clusters (Ray, Slurm), and designs trustworthy experiments to drive architectural decisions

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, particularly services related to AI/ML deployment

  • Understanding of database systems and data processing pipelines, with ClickHouse experience being a significant plus

  • Experience with embedding-based systems (retrieval, ranking, recommenders) and the representation-learning ideas underneath them

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Sales - West
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Manager, Commercial Sales - West

Location: US West (remote), strong interest for San Francisco

The Role

Our commercial segment is one of the more technically demanding sales environments in the industry. Our buyers are data engineers, platform architects, and technical founders — and the AEs who succeed here do so because they can meet those buyers as peers, not vendors. Building and leading that team requires someone who has done it themselves and knows what great looks like.

As Manager of Commercial Sales at ClickHouse, you'll own the performance, development, and culture of our Commercial AE team. You'll be expected to live in the details — reviewing pipelines, sitting on calls, pressure-testing deal strategy, and knowing every meaningful opportunity in the book. The best managers in this role won't be directing from a distance; they'll be the person their reps turn to when a deal gets complicated. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a dashboard. It's a role for someone who wants to build something.

You'll inherit a team that has real momentum, as our Commercial segment represents a significant % of our overall business.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Commercial Account Executives selling into the sub-250 employee segment — helping them close faster, think more technically, and operate with greater autonomy over time.

  • Own the Commercial segment number. You're accountable for team attainment, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy — and you'll be expected to have a clear point of view on both at any given moment.

  • Spend time in deals. Review deals, join customer conversations when it matters, and help your reps navigate the technical and commercial complexity that defines this segment.

  • Hire exceptional people. The Commercial AE profile is rare: technically credible, commercially hungry, and able to operate without hand-holding. You know how to find and close that person.

  • Build the playbook. Document what's working, codify best practices, and create repeatable frameworks for technical discovery, objection handling, and deal progression that the team can scale.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Product, and Marketing to ensure the Commercial team has the support, enablement, and feedback loops they need to win.

  • Identify patterns across the pipeline — where deals stall, where we lose, and where we consistently win — and use those insights to improve team performance and inform product and GTM decisions.

  • Contribute to the broader Commercial strategy, including segmentation, coverage model, and how we evolve the motion as the team scales.

What You Bring

  • A track record of success as a quota-carrying AE in a technical sales environment — you've sold data infrastructure, developer tooling, or a similarly technical product to engineering buyers and you know what that motion actually requires.

  • Experience leading or mentoring other sellers, whether in a formal management role or as a senior IC who took ownership of team development. You know how to coach, not just direct.

  • Technical credibility. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to earn respect in rooms full of them. You understand the modern data stack, can hold a conversation about architecture, and know enough to identify when a deal is stalling for technical reasons vs. commercial ones.

  • Strong commercial instincts. You can read a pipeline, spot sandbagging, identify risk early, and have an honest forecast conversation with leadership without needing a week to prepare.

  • A builder mentality. The playbook is still being written. You're comfortable operating in that environment and energized by the opportunity to shape it rather than frustrated by the ambiguity.

  • Genuine investment in people development. Your reps' growth is your growth. You give direct feedback, create space for people to fail safely, and take accountability for the development of everyone on your team.

Why This Role Is Different

The Commercial segment at ClickHouse is technically differentiated, growing fast, and still finding its ceiling. The person who leads it will have a direct hand in shaping how one of the most important data infrastructure companies in the industry goes to market — and will build a team that reflects their own standard of excellence.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Our buyers are data engineers, platform architects, and technical founders — and the AEs who succeed here do so because they can meet those buyers as peers, not vendors. Building and leading that team requires someone who has done it themselves and knows what great looks like.

As Manager of Commercial Sales at ClickHouse, you'll own the performance, development, and culture of our Commercial AE team. You'll be expected to live in the details — reviewing pipelines, sitting on calls, pressure-testing deal strategy, and knowing every meaningful opportunity in the book. The best managers in this role won't be directing from a distance; they'll be the person their reps turn to when a deal gets complicated. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a dashboard. It's a role for someone who wants to build something.

You'll inherit a team that has real momentum, as our Commercial segment represents a significant % of our overall business.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Commercial Account Executives selling into the sub-250 employee segment — helping them close faster, think more technically, and operate with greater autonomy over time.

 - Own the Commercial segment number. You're accountable for team attainment, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy — and you'll be expected to have a clear point of view on both at any given moment.

 - Spend time in deals. Review deals, join customer conversations when it matters, and help your reps navigate the technical and commercial complexity that defines this segment.

 - Hire exceptional people. The Commercial AE profile is rare: technically credible, commercially hungry, and able to operate without hand-holding. You know how to find and close that person.

 - Build the playbook. Document what's working, codify best practices, and create repeatable frameworks for technical discovery, objection handling, and deal progression that the team can scale.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Product, and Marketing to ensure the Commercial team has the support, enablement, and feedback loops they need to win.

 - Identify patterns across the pipeline — where deals stall, where we lose, and where we consistently win — and use those insights to improve team performance and inform product and GTM decisions.

 - Contribute to the broader Commercial strategy, including segmentation, coverage model, and how we evolve the motion as the team scales.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - A track record of success as a quota-carrying AE in a technical sales environment — you've sold data infrastructure, developer tooling, or a similarly technical product to engineering buyers and you know what that motion actually requires.

 - Experience leading or mentoring other sellers, whether in a formal management role or as a senior IC who took ownership of team development. You know how to coach, not just direct.

 - Technical credibility. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to earn respect in rooms full of them. You understand the modern data stack, can hold a conversation about architecture, and know enough to identify when a deal is stalling for technical reasons vs. commercial ones.

 - Strong commercial instincts. You can read a pipeline, spot sandbagging, identify risk early, and have an honest forecast conversation with leadership without needing a week to prepare.

 - A builder mentality. The playbook is still being written. You're comfortable operating in that environment and energized by the opportunity to shape it rather than frustrated by the ambiguity.

 - Genuine investment in people development. Your reps' growth is your growth. You give direct feedback, create space for people to fail safely, and take accountability for the development of everyone on your team.


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

The Commercial segment at ClickHouse is technically differentiated, growing fast, and still finding its ceiling. The person who leads it will have a direct hand in shaping how one of the most important data infrastructure companies in the industry goes to market — and will build a team that reflects their own standard of excellence.


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.
